versions.changelog:
Initial release of LaunchFast PPC Research skill.

- Enables Amazon PPC keyword research using up to 15 competitor ASINs.
- Extracts and segments ranked keywords by match type and opportunity tier.
- Generates a campaign-ready, Amazon-compatible Bulk Operations CSV (TSV) file.
- Previews keyword summary, tier breakdown, and negatives before CSV export.
- Provides clear upload instructions for Amazon Seller Central.
